description: A speaker zone: a stereo source selector (3 sources, wire or name its inputs from your sources), zone volume, EQ and a -3 dBFS limiter to two output channels. Use it once per zone with a prefix.

components.name: SELECT
components.label: Source
components.note:
Inputs 1-3 L/R: wire your
sources to SELECT.in.1..6.

components.name: VOL
components.label: Room volume
components.note:
Stereo gain, panel volume.
Before the AEC reference.

components.name: EQ
components.label: Speaker EQ
components.note:
Flat, bands bypassed.
Tuned on site.

components.name: LIM
components.label: Speaker limiter
components.note:
Peak limiter at -3 dBFS,
last block before the amp.

components.name: SPK
components.label: Speakers
components.note:
Flex outputs to the speakers.
Set Max Level to the amp's input.
